lifetime.original_zero_fill: Resident section-27 FAR_BSS frame 50F6 offsets 0000..4BCF are linker-zero bytes before C execution, grounded by work/data/s27_map.md and tools/farbss.py.
lifetime.runtime_fixtures: Both RTLink variants observe all 504 candidate bytes zero at main entry.
lifetime.slot_initialization: GetFreeHandle one-time initialization clears only name[0] for indices 0..3.
lifetime.close_and_reuse: CloseDB clears name[0], CloseIndex frees but does not clear the far pointer, create-file OpenDB does not clear a stale pointer, and db_CloseDataBase leaves handle words stale. Candidate adds no reset.

normal_path_basis: GetFreeHandle initializes and scans indices 0..3 at 0x7C stride; successful returns are 0..3.
OpenDB is its only caller; original code multiplies the returned slot by 0x7C and accesses segment 50F6 at 0x3958.
db_SetDataBase stores one successful returned index per active count; db_LoadObject scans below that count; db_CloseDataBase decrements and closes that entry.
db_handles values are signed database-record indices. db_SaveObject/db_ReplaceObject use index 0 under the active-database precondition.
OpenIndex stores a far dynamic IndexEntry pointer inside each record. Its allocation is count*8 and remains separate from this owner; FindIndex one-past/failure behavior is not closed.
The DOS CreateIndex, DBAdd and DBDelete write-side entry points are stubs; no SaveRec function is present in these canonical modules.

unresolved_layout_gates.trigger: four occupied name[0] slots; GetFreeHandle returns -1
unresolved_layout_gates.behavior: OpenDB calls Punt and then computes the record address if Punt returns.
unresolved_layout_gates.owner_effect: No preceding record, padding or adjacent bytes are included.
unresolved_layout_gates.required_gate: Retain as an unresolved fixed-layout preflight dependency; do not assume Punt is noreturn.

scope: v13 pure-owner boundary: two successful-path data-only FAR_BSS owners only; no historical COMDEF TU or order claim.
limits: The candidate covers successful GetFreeHandle indices 0 through 3 only; it does not make db == -1 accesses safe.

If Punt returns after GetFreeHandle returns -1, OpenDB indexes record slot -1; if execution returns to db_SetDataBase, the front-end can also write db_handles[4]. Both unchecked failure layouts remain unresolved independent gates.
No universal capacity is inferred for FindIndex's dynamic index pointer; index-entry count and allocation are per-database and separate from the four OpenDBRec records.
The probe confirms fresh MSC 6.00AX/RTLink CRT behavior and the source-functional OMF shape; it makes no original historical C translation-unit, communal-order, or provider ownership claim.
Original resident section-27 FAR_BSS zero-fill is grounded separately by work/data/s27_map.md and tools/farbss.py; no original image or database asset is a compiler/linker/runtime input.
CloseDB clears only name[0]; CloseIndex frees but does not clear the index pointer; db_CloseDataBase leaves db_handles stale. The provider does not add resets or cleanup.
The candidate can be considered only as a natural normal-path storage provider; it does not close either database failure-path layout gate.
Initialized/indexed ownership is outside this v13 pure-owner candidate and remains a later batch.
No extent is inferred from neighboring addresses and no padding is added.
